principle: Calibrate TOPA on cases where transmission/convergence should be distinguishable before interpreting any surprising survivor.

queue.why_first: Ancient Near Eastern transmission hypotheses and generic flood convergence provide both a strong dependence null and a strong convergence null.
queue.killer_falsifier: If clustering depends on generic flood features, translation vocabulary, duplicated textual roots or one feature family, the method fails calibration.

queue.why_second: Reciprocity-like ethics are expected to recur under ordinary social coordination and should therefore produce low-specificity cross-tradition similarity.
queue.killer_falsifier: If TOPA promotes generic reciprocity wording as mysterious residual, specificity is inadequate and later motif claims are blocked.
queue.promotion_ceiling: CONVERGENCE_EXPECTED unless rare ordered structure survives controls

queue.why_third: Translation can falsely merge resurrection, rebirth, revivification, afterlife, apotheosis, seasonal return and mythic descent/ascent into one category.
queue.killer_falsifier: If the apparent pattern vanishes after original-language ontology separation, record CATEGORY_COLLAPSE and stop.

queue.why_fourth: Creation from darkness, waters, void, separation or ordering is broad; only rare ordered bundles have useful specificity.
queue.killer_falsifier: Matched non-sacred cosmogonic and philosophical controls reproduce the same bundle at similar frequency.

queue.why_fifth: Norm systems recur naturally, but their authority structure, reciprocity, sanction model and transmission form may preserve historically informative differences.
queue.killer_falsifier: Similarity is explainable by broad institutional functions rather than rare textual/structural features.

queue.why_sixth: Judgment, renovation, apocalypse and cyclic renewal are often historically connected or conceptually non-equivalent; chronology and ontology must precede motif scoring.
queue.killer_falsifier: The cluster dissolves after separating linear judgment, cyclical cosmology and historically connected apocalyptic traditions.

queue.why_seventh: Mountains, trees and water have obvious ecological and perceptual salience, making them a strong test of over-harmonization.
queue.killer_falsifier: The result requires collapsing mountain, tree, river, pillar and center into one analyst-created meta-symbol.
queue.promotion_ceiling: CONVERGENCE_EXPECTED unless rare textual structure survives

global_stop_rules: If Q01 fails calibration, freeze later residual promotion until the scoring method is repaired.
If Q02 is incorrectly promoted as mysterious on generic features, reduce motif specificity weights before continuing.
No queue item may inherit a conclusion from a previous item; only validated method components may transfer.
Every negative result remains in the corpus as a calibration certificate.
success_definition: The queue succeeds if TOPA reliably demotes ordinary convergence and known transmission while preserving only reproducible, provenance-bound residual questions.
failure_definition: The queue fails if it preferentially manufactures mystery from broad motifs, translation artifacts, duplicated roots or analyst-selected ontology.
